question: Build the master chaperone-tissue interaction table (Source → Target → Signal → Temporal window) for inducing pronephric program in adjacent competent tissue.
direct_answer: MASTER CHAPERONE-TISSUE INTERACTION TABLE — inducing the pronephric program in adjacent competent tissue (zebrafish, GRCz11). Target throughout = intermediate mesoderm (IM)/posterior lateral plate mesoderm, the competent field forming the bilateral pronephros. Rows [Source → Signal (verified gene) → Target → Window → role]: (1) Anterior paraxial mesoderm/somites → Retinoic acid synthesis, aldh1a2 (ENSDARG00000053493) → IM anterior/proximal → ~8-18 hpf → proximo-distal patterning, sets proximal segment identity — STRONGEST/best-validated input. (2) Posterior mesoderm/tailbud → RA degradation (counter-gradient), cyp26a1 (ENSDARG00000033999) + cyp26b1 (ENSDARG00000077121) → IM posterior/distal → ~8-18 hpf → clears RA posteriorly for distal identity. (3) Tailbud/posterior paraxial mesoderm → posteriorizing Wnt, wnt8a (ENSDARG00000052910) + wnt2ba (ENSDARG00000005050) → posterior LPM/IM → ~6-12 hpf → posteriorizes mesoderm, establishes posterior competence field. (4) Tailbud/posterior mesoderm → FGF, fgf8a (ENSDARG00000003399) + fgf24 (ENSDARG00000037677) → posterior LPM/IM → ~8-16 hpf → posterior mesoderm/IM specification. (5) Ventral/ventrolateral mesoderm → BMP, bmp2b (ENSDARG00000041430) → prospective IM → ~5-10 hpf → competence-establishing DV patterning (earliest). (6) Notochord/floor plate → Hedgehog, shha (ENSDARG00000068567) → medial IM → ~10-18 hpf → modest midline patterning input (exploratory, weakest). COMPANION READOUT MODULE (target-intrinsic response TFs = what 'competent' means, not source signals): osr1 (ENSDARG00000014091, earliest IM ~8-10 hpf), pax2a (ENSDARG00000028148, master specifier ~10-12 hpf), pax8 (ENSDARG00000015879), lhx1a (ENSDARG00000014018), wt1a/wt1b (ENSDARG00000031420/ENSDARG00000007990, podocyte ~14-24 hpf), hnf1ba (ENSDARG00000006615, tubule ~18-24 hpf). This is a DESIGN SCAFFOLD: all gene IDs are tool-verified, but the induction-SUFFICIENCY claim (that these signals reconstitute the program in competent tissue) is a causal-pruner-class hypothesis requiring a human gate + wet-lab GOF (Phase II) — not a validated protocol. HTML report: reports/2026-07-11_chaperone-tissue-interaction-table_v1.html.

alternatives_considered: Single-signal (RA-only) induction model — rejected as incomplete: RA patterns proximo-distal identity but does not establish the posterior competence field (Wnt/FGF) nor the DV origin (BMP)

Notch (jag2b/deltaC) as a source-inducing signal — rejected for this table: Notch acts WITHIN the pronephros for multiciliated-vs-epithelial cell-fate patterning, not as a source→competent-tissue inducer; belongs to a later cell-fate table
Treating pax2a/osr1/wt1/lhx1a as 'signals' — rejected: these are target-intrinsic response TFs (readout of competence), separated into the companion module
Rolling everything into one confidence number — rejected per §5: used confidence_by_subclaim because ID-binding (0.97) and induction-sufficiency (0.25) differ materially
gap_flags: No native perturbation-sufficiency evidence in the DI that any listed signal INDUCES pronephros in ectopic/adjacent competent tissue — the sufficiency column is a hypothesis (confidence ~0.25), human-gate + wet-lab GOF required (Phase II)

Temporal windows (hpf brackets) are literature/domain-derived, NOT retrieved from a structured tool this session; ZESTA spatiotemporal atlas (CORPUS-2026-0001) is source-pointer only and was not queried — windows are the weakest load-bearing column (~0.40)
